code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"research-agent"})
can="".join(S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/O94818.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])
pdbtxt=S.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-O94818-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=90).text
plddt={int(l[22:26]):float(l[60:66]) for l in pdbtxt.splitlines() if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA"}
pos=np.array(sorted(plddt)); pl=np.array([plddt[i] for i in pos])
def chg(s): return s.count('K')+s.count('R')-s.count('D')-s.count('E')
w=15; ncpr=np.array([chg(can[i:i+w])/w for i in range(len(can)-w+1)]); xc=np.arange(len(ncpr))+1+w//2

fig,axs=plt.subplots(3,1,figsize=(13,10),gridspec_kw={'height_ratios':[1.1,1.1,1.5]})
ax=axs[0]
ax.plot(pos,pl,lw=0.9,color='#2b6cb0'); ax.axhline(70,ls='--',c='grey',lw=0.8); ax.axhline(50,ls=':',c='grey',lw=0.8)
ax.axvspan(406,500,color='#f6ad55',alpha=.35); ax.axvspan(4,129,color='#9ae6b4',alpha=.35); ax.axvspan(602,638,color='#bee3f8',alpha=.5)
ax.text(453,103,"IPR056549 'HTH_NOL4'\n406-500",ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.text(66,103,"PF47726 N-term",ha='center',fontsize=8); ax.text(620,103,"PF38089",ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("AlphaFold pLDDT"); ax.set_ylim(0,118); ax.set_xlim(1,638)
ax.set_title("NOL4 (O94818): 45% of residues have pLDDT<50; the 406-500 domain is confidently folded (mean 87.2)",fontsize=10)

ax=axs[1]
ax.plot(xc,ncpr,lw=0.9,color='#742a2a'); ax.axhline(0,c='k',lw=0.6)
ax.fill_between(xc,0,ncpr,where=ncpr>0,color='#3182ce',alpha=.5)
ax.fill_between(xc,0,ncpr,where=ncpr<0,color='#e53e3e',alpha=.5)
ax.axvspan(406,500,color='#f6ad55',alpha=.25)
ax.axvspan(456,485,color='none',ec='k',lw=1.6,ls='--')
ax.annotate("Ueki 1998 nucleolar-targeting region\n(canonical 456-485), sufficient for\nnucleolar localisation in COS-7",
            xy=(470,0.53),xytext=(300,0.62),fontsize=8,arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->',lw=0.9))
ax.set_ylabel("Net charge per residue\n(window 15)"); ax.set_xlim(1,638); ax.set_xlabel("NOL4 residue")

ax=axs[2]; ax.axis('off')
bench=pd.DataFrame([
 ["1HDD_C","Engrailed homeodomain + DNA","DNA-binding HTH",1,"28-38 / GLNEA / 44-57","106.4",19.3,9],
 ["1R69_A","434 repressor N-term HTH","DNA-binding HTH",3,"2-12 / LGLN / 17-24","97.9",4.8,2],
 ["6CRO_A","Cro repressor HTH","DNA-binding HTH",1,"16-23 / GVY / 27-36","101.1",5.0,1],
 ["1LMB_3","Lambda repressor DBD + DNA","DNA-binding HTH",1,"33-40 / GMG / 44-51","91.9",5.7,0],
 ["256B_A","Cytochrome b562 bundle","helical bundle, no NA",0,"none","-",7.5,2],
 ["1BBH_A","Cytochrome c' bundle","helical bundle, no NA",0,"none","-",6.9,3],
 ["1NKL_A","NK-lysin saposin fold","helical bundle, no NA",0,"none","-",16.7,7],
 ["NOL4","406-500 'HTH_NOL4'","QUERY",0,"434-447 / FPEY / 452-470","123.1",17.9,8],
 ["NOL4","4-129 N-term domain","QUERY",0,"none","-",7.9,5]],
 columns=["PDB/model","Description","Class","HTH-like\nhelix pairs","closest helix-turn-helix unit","inter-\nhelical°","largest + patch\n(per 100 res)","patch net\ncharge"])
t=ax.table(cellText=bench.values,colLabels=bench.columns,loc='center',cellLoc='center')
t.auto_set_font_size(False); t.set_fontsize(7.4); t.scale(1,1.55)
for j in range(len(bench.columns)): t[0,j].set_facecolor('#2d3748'); t[0,j].set_text_props(color='w',weight='bold')
for i in range(1,len(bench)+1):
    c={'DNA-binding HTH':'#c6f6d5','helical bundle, no NA':'#e2e8f0','QUERY':'#fed7d7'}[bench.Class[i-1]]
    for j in range(len(bench.columns)): t[i,j].set_facecolor(c)
ax.set_title("Calibrated HTH geometry test (Kabsch-Sander helices; HTH-like = 2-5 residue turn, 6-12 and 6-14 aa helices, 70-145°)\n"
             "4/4 true HTH domains score >=1; 0/3 non-nucleic-acid bundles and 0/2 NOL4 domains score any",fontsize=9.5,pad=14)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
